rebuilt_2026_11_22.reason: Makes ClipAnalyzer time its own detectForVideo calls and report the delegate that actually ran, and suppresses the camera-only statistics on the clip path.
rebuilt_2026_11_22.why_it_mattered: The detector has TWO separate HandLandmarker instances. ClipAnalyzer builds its own and never wrote to HandTracker.profiler, so the HUD per-frame p95 line was reporting LIVE-CAMERA frames under a clip result. Proven on a cold-started app that had never opened the camera: it still showed detect 46 ms on a clip. Every file-pick latency this project previously published (the 50-59 ms span, and this entry formerly 51/50 ms) came from that defect and is retracted.
rebuilt_2026_11_22.measured_on_device: Four file-pick classifications on THIS build, signed with the same key (cert 6573b6fd...1bb97), diagnostics off: NOON1 detect p95 58 ms (32 frames), DARK1 65 ms (25 frames), MECHANIC1 67 ms (32 frames), MECHANIC1 again 72 ms (32 frames). GPU delegate each time, not a silent CPU fallback. All four are over the 50 ms target. The two MECHANIC1 samples are the same clip, so the 5 ms gap between them is run-to-run variance on one device.
